The v0.6.0-rc2 desktop publication failed on the windows-2025 builder: nine desktop node:test cases assume a POSIX host (three spawn /bin/sh to source the profile block, five assert exact Unix file modes such as 0600/0644/0755, one relies on rename failing over a directory). CI only checks the desktop shell on macos-15 and ubuntu-24.04, so the release matrix was the first place the tests ran on Windows, and the macOS and Ubuntu builds were cancelled with it. The CLI release v0.6.0-rc2 published; desktop-v0.6.0-rc2 is tagged with no release and desktop-latest still serves rc1.

Acceptance:
- The POSIX-only tests are skipped on win32 with a reason (the registry runner fake already covers Windows behavior), or rewritten to be platform-neutral where that is cheap; no test is deleted.
- ci.yml verifies the desktop checks on windows-2025 as well, so a Windows-only failure is caught on the pull request rather than at release time.
- A desktop rerun builds the tag as it was (CONTRIBUTING, Desktop releases), so rerunning desktop-v0.6.0-rc2 would fail identically. After merge, cut v0.6.0-rc3 from main; the cascade tags desktop-v0.6.0-rc3 and refreshes desktop-latest. desktop-v0.6.0-rc2 stays as a tag with no release.
